# Ubuntu 24.04 packages for the Linux jobs of .github/workflows/build.yml,
# installed from the runner image's own archive (same names on amd64/arm64).
# vcpkg builds the libraries; these are the build tools and the system
# headers its ports expect from the OS.

# Build tools
build-essential ninja-build cmake pkg-config ccache file git curl zip unzip tar
# Autotools/meson ports (alsa, libsodium, libxcrypt, libmount, libsystemd)
autoconf autoconf-archive automake libtool libltdl-dev autopoint gettext bison flex gperf nasm
python3 python3-venv python3-jinja2 linux-libc-dev
# SDL3 X11 and Wayland video, IBus input, EGL/GL for bgfx
libx11-dev libxft-dev libxext-dev libxrandr-dev libxcursor-dev libxi-dev
libxinerama-dev libxss-dev libxtst-dev libxfixes-dev libxrender-dev
libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev wayland-protocols libdecor-0-dev
libegl1-mesa-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libgles2-mesa-dev libdrm-dev libgbm-dev
libibus-1.0-dev libdbus-1-dev libudev-dev
# Audio headers
libasound2-dev libpulse-dev
